o.text: Borrowed from Arabic بَعْضًا (baʕḍan). By surface analysis, bəzi (“some”) + -ən.

From pilotsuz (“pilotless”) + izafet II compound of uçuş (“flight”) + aparat (“device”).
Calque of Russian беспило́тный лета́тельный аппара́т (bespilótnyj letátelʹnyj apparát).
